heading: **19 February 2026**
body:
*New samples to be sequenced for PacBio*

1. lig50k (sheared to 20k) \- No Hia5 treatment  
2. 293T (sheared to 20k) \+ nucleosomes \+ Hia5  
3. Plasmid Fiber-Seq HAP1 HRS- 12  
4. Plasmid Fiber-Seq HAP1 HRS- 18  
5. Plasmid Fiber-Seq HepG2 HRS- 12  
6. Plasmid Fiber-Seq HepG2 HRS- 18  
7. 147HTFS  
8. N40HTFS  
9. 147NCFS  
10. N40NCFS

*ELF2 \+ nucleosome native gel re-run*

Load 30 ng each of the samples in the following order:

1. ELF2 lig1  
2. ELF2 lig1 (EcoRV)  
3. ELF2 lig1nuc (EcoRV)  
4. ELF2 lig1 \+ ELF2 (EcoRV)  
5. ELF2 lig1nuc \+ ELF2 (EcoRV)

*MNase test for nucleosome recon*

Collect & quantify the F1 sample (293T20knuc).

10 ng of sample \+ 5 uL MNase buffer \+ 1 uL dMNase \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin (total 50 uL)

Treat at 37 C, 10 mins.

Run on a 1% agarose gel and stain with SYBR Green. 

*NCFS*

- Aliquot 7.5 uL per well of PCR master-mix  
- Add PE\_R primer with barcodes (1.5 uL) (PE2)  
- Add 9 uL of cyc3 DNA

For both ligands the PCR will be 25 cycles in total.

*ELF2lig1 PCR*

16X

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ELFlig1** | **2 uL** |
| **2X KAPA Mix** | **200 uL** |
| **ELF\_FWD 10 uM** | **20 uL** |
| **ELF\_REV1 10 uM** | **20 uL** |
| **Water** | **158 uL** |
| **Total** | **400** |

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 59°C | 15 s       **35X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 10 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

*Hia5 treatment for 293T20knuc*

F1

* Prepare dHia5 ⇒ 3 uL enzyme \+ 3 uL of Hia5 buffer  
* Prepare Master-Mix \= 2100 ng 293T20knuc \+ 3 uL SAM \+ 6 uL dHia5 (120 uL total volume)  
* Aliquot 20 uL each to tubes.  
* Incubate 37 C, 60 mins.

After Hia5 treatment, add 0.5 uL 10% SDS & 0.5 uL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) in 20 uL reactions and incubate 50 degrees, 15 mins.

Pool samples and purify with 1X Ampure XP beads.
title: New samples to be sequenced for PacBio
